abstract: The role of preoperative CA 19-9 levels in patients with ovarian mature cystic teratoma (MCT) and the association of elevated levels of the biomarker with patients' and tumor characteristics were evaluated. Four electronic databases were searched for articles published up to September 2019. Trials that evaluated the significance of elevated CA 19-9 in patients with ovarian MCTs and publications with > 20 patients were considered eligible for inclusion. Seven studies that included 995 patients with an ovarian MCT who were evaluated with elevated (n = 364) or normal (n = 631) CA 19-9 levels were included. Mean tumor size was significantly increased in patients with elevated CA 19-9 levels (p = 0.038). The rate of ovarian torsion was significantly increased in the elevated CA 19-9 group (p = 0.04). The present study highlights the importance of CA 19-9 as a marker in the diagnosis of MCT, and a meta-analysis supports that it could raise a high degree of clinical suspicion of early recognition of torsion and early surgical management due to complications related to increased size. Nonetheless, the diagnostic value of CA 19-9 is still limited and CA 19-9 can still serve only as a supplementary diagnostic tool in patients with MCTs.
abstract_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(MCT)患者における術前CA 19-9値の役割、および本バイオマーカーの高値と患者および腫瘍の特徴との関連を評価した。4つの電子データベースを用い、2019年9月までに発表された論文を検索した。CA 19-9高値の卵巣MCT患者における意義を評価した試験、および20例を超える症例を含む論文を適格基準とした。CA 19-9高値(n = 364)または正常(n = 631)の卵巣MCT患者995例を含む7つの研究を組み入れた。CA 19-9高値の患者では平均腫瘍径が有意に大きかった(p = 0.038）。CA 19-9高値群では卵巣捻転の頻度が有意に高かった(p = 0.04)。本研究は、MCTの診断マーカーとしてのCA 19-9の重要性を強調し、メタ解析により、腫瘍径増大に伴う合併症のため、捻転の早期認識と早期外科的管理に対する高度な臨床的疑いを持つべきことが支持された。とはいえ、CA 19-9の診断的価値はなお限定的であり、MCT患者において補助的な診断ツールとしてしか役立たない。
